data.narrative:
Impulse Labs is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Sam D'Amico that has raised $25M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 frontier-tech peers in Climate & Energy—1 public company (LNZA) and 8 private firms including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Given the nascent stage and heterogeneity of the peer set, peer-median valuation proved inapplicable; no subset of 3+ comparables shared both Impulse Labs' stage and valuation tier. Consequently, stage-progression analysis was the primary method employed. Using total capital raised ($25M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier between Series A and later rounds yields an implied valuation of $50M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $42M to $57M, centered on $50M. This range reflects the mechanics of the stage-progression method; the narrow width reflects reliance on a single applicable approach. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.0x multiplier for this specific company and sector, and the absence of direct peer benchmarks at Impulse Labs' particular stage and scale. A more granular range would require either expanded peer data or operational metrics (revenue, customer concentration, unit economics) not provided here.
